GRANTING PERMISSION BY VIRTUE OF POWERS VESTED IN ME UNDER SECTION 27(A) OF PROVINCIAL COUNCIL ACT No. 42 OF 1987 AS THE TERM OF THE SIXTH SABARAGAMUWA PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA ENDED ON 26TH SEPTEMBER, 2017.
1. This permission may be cited as “Permission to disburse under the second supplementary financial statement - 2024 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council” and come in to operation from 27.03.2024.

2. The expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which is estimated Rupees Forty Nine Billion Nine Hundred and Thirty Two Million One Hundred and Sixty Seven Thousand Only (Rs. 49,932,167,000.00) for the service of the period beginning on 01st of January, 2024 and ending 31st December 2024, which is speciﬁ ed as “Financial Year 2024” in the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue – Expenditure Estimates prepared for the year 2024, is hereby amended as, Rupees Fifty Billion One Hundred and Seventy Six Million Nine Hundred and Thirty Eight Thousand and Six Cents Seventy Three only (Rs. 50,176,938,006.73) and grant permission to the Chief Secretary of this Province and other Accounting Oﬃ cers to disburse the same from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to disburse as per the ﬁ rst Supplementary Financial statement for the year 2024, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Rupees Fifty Billion One Hundred and Seventy Six Million Nine Hundred and Thirty Eight Thousand Six and Cents Seventy Three only (Rs. 50,176,938,006.73/-) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the one year period that starts on 1st of January, 2024 and end on 31st of December, 2024.

This permission will be valid till 31st of December, 2024 or upto the date that expires three months (03) from the date of summoning the Seventh (07th) Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
Nൺඏංඇ Dංඌඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ, Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province. 27th day of March, 2024
